I'll have the power off in no time.|Cad Bane and Robonino|audio=Bubblebrain2.flac|}} '''Robonino''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[Patrolian]] [[bounty hunter]] who was active during the [[Clone Wars]], performing several jobs at the expense of the [[Galactic Republic]] on [[Coruscant]]. He teamed up with [[Cad Bane]], [[Shahan Alama]], and [[Aurra Sing]] during the [[Senate hostage crisis]]. He was later hired by [[Count]] [[Dooku]] to harass several Republic [[senator]]s who were attempting to stop a [[Republic military enhancement bill|bill]] that would escalate the Clone Wars. ==Biography== [[File:SpeederChase-POP.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Robonino pursues Senator Amidala through the skyways of Coruscant]] During the [[Clone Wars]], Robonino made himself a career as a [[bounty hunter]]. He was part of a [[Cad Bane's group|group]] led by the notorious [[Duros]] bounty hunter [[Cad Bane]] that took the [[Imperial Senate Building|Senate Building]] [[Senate hostage crisis|hostage]] in order to free [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure|Ziro]] the [[Hutt]]. While the others made their way through the building to locate hostages, Robonino sabotaged the power distribution network of the Senate Building from the control room. He then triggered the emergency lock-down in the adjacent [[Imperial Executive Building|Senate Office Building]], which allowed Bane to execute the rest of his plan. Robonino remained in the control room, and when [[Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] arrived to investigate the outage, the crafty Patrolian was able to get the jump on the skilled Jedi by grabbing him from behind and electrocuting him while Skywalker was occupied by attacks from Robonino's comrades [[Shahan Alama]] and [[Aurra Sing]]. After the Hutt was freed, Robonino left the crime scene along with the rest of the group. Although Robonino and the others were chased while escaping but Bane manage to steal the Jedi off course.{{TCW|Dangerous Debt}} Later, Robonino, along with [[Chata Hyoki]], were hired by [[Count]] [[Dooku]] to intimidate various [[senator]]s to try to stop a vote on a [[Republic military enhancement bill|Senate bill]]. Dooku later instructed them to [[assassin]]ate [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]]. The next evening, Robonino and Hyoki tracked Amidala down through the streets of Coruscant and attacked. However, Amidala was able to shake them and escape via a [[speeder]]. Despite their failure, Robonino and Hyoki nonetheless moved on their next target, attacking Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]] in the Senate Building [[Hangar]] one morning and gravely injuring him. However, Robonino and his partner were arrested by police forces.{{TCW|Pursuit of Peace}} ==Personality and traits== Robonino was a [[Patrolian]] [[Gender|male]] who was 1.27 [[meter]]s, or 4 [[Foot|feet]], 2 inches tall. He had [[Color|red]] [[eye]]s and light purple skin. Robonino was bounty hunter with a variety of skills, able to infiltrate the Senate building, sabotage the power grid, drive a speeder, and use the element of surprise to take down a Jedi. Robonino had an eyepatch covering his left eye. ==Skills and abilities== Robonino was skilled in infiltration, [[Slicer|data slicing]], [[Saboteur|sabotage]] and explosives handling.
